definitions.explanation: A small, rounded stone, typically found on beaches, riverbeds, or paths.

examples.japanese: {小石|こいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投|な}げた→投げる：01135_nageru⟧。
examples.english: I threw a pebble into the river.
A pebble got into my shoe.

examples.japanese: {川原|かわら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{小石|こいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}って→拾う：00845_hirou⟧⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I picked up pebbles on the riverbed and skipped them on the water.

notes:
{小石|こいし} is composed of ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small) + ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧ (stone). Refers to small, smooth stones typically found on riverbanks, beaches, and paths.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {小石|こいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧: to pick up pebbles
- {小石|こいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧: to throw pebbles
- {小石|こいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蹴|け}る→蹴る：02054_keru⟧: to kick pebbles
- {小石|こいし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{敷|し}き{詰|つ}められた→敷き詰める：17557_shikitsumeru⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: a pebble-covered path

SIZE SCALE:
- ⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧: sand
- {小石|こいし}: pebble, small stone
- ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧: stone (general term)
- ⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧: rock, boulder
- ⟦{砂利|じゃり}→砂利：14948_jari⟧: gravel (collection of small stones)

USAGE:
⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧ (stone skipping) is a popular activity where you throw a flat {小石|こいし} across water to make it bounce.
